title: Power-Up / Power-Down / Format Family
slide_intent: Adapt a recognizable animation to different screen shapes so device constraints do not fragment the identity.
strategic_value: A shared current-to-logo sequence can make Spectrum’s mobile startup behavior recognizable across devices.
demonstration: Six differently proportioned blue rectangles align along a baseline and run a synchronized current-to-logo animation in a 4.21-second composite.
practical_value: Compare the placement and scale of the current and logo across tall, wide and small screen formats.

content_islands.name: Format family
content_islands.spec: Arrange six blue screens from tall portrait at left through landscape and a small rectangle at right, aligned at their lower edges.

content_islands.name: Synchronized identity
content_islands.spec: Run the flowing current, luminous reveal and white logo across all six panels so format differences remain directly comparable.

ingredient.name: Mobile identity sequence
ingredient.role: Identify the service during device startup or shutdown.
ingredient.application: Use the tagline-free power-up/power-down sequence adapted to device dimensions. The agency describes more than 40 delivered formats at 15 frames per second.
ingredient.scope: The six-screen composite illustrates the delivery family. Its playback file is not evidence that all 40 production formats are present.
